svg.title: 4. Full Flow — High Level
svg.text: The conservative overview. Every badge is scoped to what current evidence supports.
lint, tests where they exist, build, Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL
gate, CycloneDX SBOM, container health check
immutable tags; the digest is the artifact identity
one account; Organizations is plumbing only
Route 53 and ACM selected for the domain phase
private worker nodes, one NAT Gateway,
AWS-managed control plane outside the VPC
state, registry, secrets, IAM roles, evidence store
one per environment; the only telemetry entry point
Validated across four closed runtime windows. Not
CI/CD: 3 of 17 justified services have a validated build, scan, SBOM and health path (checkout, shipping, quote). 3 of 17 are lint-only or partial
(frontend, payment, product-catalog). 11 of 17 are not yet wired.
Coverage for all 17 justified services is mandatory under Accepted ADR-0014 and is incomplete today. Language-tier templates are an implementation
Runtime is not live and no window is currently authorized. Three services have published images read back by digest, so there is per-service digest
evidence but no fleet-wide publication. Promotion and rollback are accepted architecture and have not been exercised.
The sequence above is the target flow, not a statement that it runs today; the status panel states which segments are proven. Ephemeral runtime resources are
removed after every approved window, and persistent foundation resources are intentionally retained. The platform is the product, and AstroShop is the workload
VALIDATED proven by captured evidence, at the badge's stated scope
PARTIAL capability exists for part of the fleet only
NOT LIVE implemented and validated in closed windows; no runtime now
PLANNED accepted or designed, not yet exercised
RETAINED survives environment teardown by design
